title: Nothing stuck to him. Until his right-hand man started singing 🎤
caption:
John Gotti, the Teflon Don, brought down by Sammy the Bull 🐂
Tag the friend who'd never snitch 👇
first_comment: Tag the friend who'd never snitch 👇
sources: FBI, 'John Gotti' (History: Famous Cases) (Gambino boss after the murder of Paul Castellano outside Sparks Steak House, 16 Dec 1985; bugged apartment above the Ravenite Social Club; convicted 1992, life without parole; died 2002)
Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'John Gotti' ('Dapper Don', 'Teflon Don'; acquittals in 1986, 1987 and 1990)
The New York Times (1991-92) coverage of Salvatore 'Sammy the Bull' Gravano's testimony (admitted 19 murders)
